description:
Configure the 'Sales Invoice' email template in Manager.io settings. Navigate to Settings > Email Templates. If a template for 'Sales Invoice' does not exist, create a new one. Set the Subject to 'Invoice {{Reference}} from Northwind Traders'. Set the Body to:

Dear Customer,

Please find attached your invoice dated {{IssueDate}}.

Thank you for your business.

Ensure you preserve the {{Reference}} and {{IssueDate}} placeholders exactly as shown. Save the template.

expected_body_snippets: Please find attached your invoice dated {{IssueDate}}.
